description: Land Title Settlement Department - Magalla, Four Gravets Galle D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810012
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in various locations in Galle District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
